extraction_notes: Datasheet covers the B0520WS/B0530WS/B0540WS family; all spec values taken from the B0520WS column. Marking code for B0520WS is SD.

Curves digitized programmatically from a 300 dpi raster of page 2: plot-box borders and log-decade gridlines located by pixel line detection, gridline positions cross-checked against standard log-minor spacing (fit within ~1 px), then curve centerlines sampled per row/column while excluding gridline and in-plot text-label pixels. Estimated accuracy ~1-2% of axis span.

Digitized typical curves are consistent with table limits: 25C forward curve gives ~291 mV at 0.1 A (max 330 mV) and ~370 mV at 0.48 A (max 385 mV at 0.5 A); 25C reverse curve gives ~0.05 mA at ~20 V (max 0.25 mA).
Additional maximum reverse-current point for B0520WS not representable in the single reverse_current slot: IR max 0.075 mA at VR=10V, Ta=25C (page 2).
Maximum ratings for B0520WS (page 1): VRRM=20V, VRMS=14V, VDC=20V, IF(AV)=0.5A, IFSM=5.5A (8.3 ms half-sine), PD=200mW, Tj=-55 to +125C, Tstg=-55 to +150C, RthJA=500C/W (typical). Package SOD-123.

breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null because the datasheet specifies only maximum-rating reverse voltages (VRRM=20V); no avalanche/breakdown VBR test point is given. reverse_recovery is null because no trr specification appears anywhere in the datasheet.
Fig.2 printed x-axis labels are transposed (…10, 20, 15, 25…); uniform tick spacing confirms a linear 0-30 V axis and points were mapped accordingly.
Fig.4 power derating curve (PD vs Ta, linear axes: 200 mW flat to 25C, linearly derating to 0 at ~125C) was inspected but not digitized; it restates PD/Tj ratings.
No vendor SPICE models or model packs were used; all evidence is from the public datasheet PDF.
